ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AD = \frac{1}{2}DB$, and $E$ is the midpoint of $BC$, with $BE = \frac{1}{5}AC = 2\, \text{cm}$. How long is segment $DE$ in centimeters?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} By the problem statement, we know $DB=\frac{2}{3}AB$, $BE=EC=2\text{cm}$, and $AC=10\text{cm}$. \\
$\therefore$ $AB=AC-BC=6\text{cm}$. \\
$\therefore$ $DB=\frac{2}{3}AB=4\text{cm}$. \\
$\therefore$ $DE=DB+BE=\boxed{6}\text{cm}$.
